questions.question_bn: Charged particle momentum 7 kg·m/s, |q|=2 C,B=3 T; v⊥B। orbit radius কত m?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 7। Magnetic centripetal balance |q|vB=mv²/r⇒r=p/(|q|B)=(7)/6।

questions.question_bn: River width 30 m, current 4 m/s। boat-এর water-relative speed 3 m/s, সোজা bank-normal steer করে। drift কত m?

questions.question_bn: Rest energy mc²=9 J। total relativistic energy 2mc² হলে kinetic energy কত J?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 9। Total E=K+mc²। K=2mc²−mc²=mc²=nJ; total ও kinetic energy আলাদা।

questions.question_bn: Spring k=6 N/m। 1 m থেকে 3 m stretch করতে work কত J?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 3। ΔU=½k(3²−1²)=½·2×(3)·8=8×(3)। final energy আর additional work পৃথক।

questions.question_bn: V(x)=7x²−6x volts। x=2 m-এ Ex কত V/m?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 7। Electric field Ex=−dV/dx=−2nx+6। x=2 দিলে 6−4×(7); negative gradient sign জরুরি।

questions.question_bn: Supply 7 V, forward Si diode drop 0.7 V ও Ge drop 0.3 V series with 1kΩ। current কত mA?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 6। Assume both forward conducting at stated constant drops। resistor voltage V−(0.7+0.3)=nV। I=(6)/1000A=(6) mA।

questions.question_bn: Edges a=(7,0,0), b=(1,2,0), c=(0,1,3) m। parallelepiped volume কত m³?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 7। Volume=|a·(b×c)|। triangular matrix-এর determinant (7)·2·3=6×(7); skew components প্রভাব ফেলে না।

questions.question_bn: SameY,AwireslengthL ও 2Lseries,F=4N। longwireextension/shortwireextension কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 4। Serieswirestensionsame। extensionFL/(AY)∝length⇒longtwice; parallelextensionequal এখানেপ্রযোজ্যনয়।

questions.question_bn: Convexlensf 8 cm gives real image 2timesobjectsize। object distance কত cm?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 8। Real image|m|=v/u=2⇒v2u।1/f=1/u+1/(2u)=3/(2u)⇒u=1.5f。

questions.question_bn: Horizontal table-এ mass 10 kg, μk=0.2; pulley-তে hanging mass 10 kg। g=10, ideal rope। acceleration কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 10। Driving force mg−μmg=8×(10) N; total mass 2×(10)। a=8×(10)/(2×(10))=4 m/s²।

questions.question_bn: Source frequency 4Hzapproachesstationaryreflectingwallatvsource=c/3। sourceandwallinair,receiver stationary behind source। reflected wave frequency কত Hz?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 4। Wallstationaryhearsfwall=f c/(c−vs)=1.5×(4)। stationary reflection preserves wall frame frequency; receiver stationary also hears 1.5×(4)।
questions.subject: Physics

questions.question_bn: Concave mirror f=9 cm। object 2f-এ। image position কোথায়?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 9। Mirror formula 1/f=1/u+1/v, u=2f⇒v=2f। real inverted same-size image at centre of curvature।

questions.question_bn: Mass 10 kg,SHA springk=40 N/m,amplitude 0.1m। equilibrium through speed কত m/s?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 10। ω=√(k/m)=2s⁻¹。 vmax=ωA=0.2 m/s; all spring energy kinetic at same equilibrium।

questions.question_bn: v(t)=5−2t m/s, 0≤t≤5 s। total distance কত m?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 5। v=0 at (5)/2। v-t graph-এর দুই triangle area (5)²/4 করে; distance মোট (5)²/2।

questions.question_bn: Ag Cl Ksp=1×10⁻¹⁰। Na Cl solution [Cl⁻]=23×10⁻²M, Ag Cl saturated; s≪[Cl⁻]। [Ag⁺] কত M?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 23। Ksp=[Ag⁺][Cl⁻]। common-ion approximation s=10⁻¹⁰/((23)×10⁻²)=(1/(23))×10⁻⁸M।

questions.question_bn: M²⁺+2e⁻→M(s),25°C। ion concentration 10⁻18M। E−E° কত V?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 18। Q=1/[M²⁺]=10ⁿ, solidsactivity 1। Nernstshift−0.0592×(18)/2=−0.0296nV; dilution reduction potential কমায়।

questions.question_bn: CathodereductionE°=4/10 V,anodereductionE°=−0.20 V। E°cell কত V?

questions.question_bn: Two equal bond dipoles μ=7D make 120°। net dipole কত D?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 7। Vector resultant 2μcos60°=μ=nD। linear 180°-এ zero; dipoles scalar যোগ নয়।

questions.question_bn: Gas A molar mass 9, B mass 36 g/mol। equalT-তে diffusion rA/rB কত?

questions.question_bn: H-like ion Z=25, transition 3→2। photon energy/13.6eV কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 25। Energy difference Z²(1/2²−1/3²)=Z²(1/4−1/9)=5Z²/36। emission energy positive।

questions.question_bn: Impure CaCO₃sample excessHCl 84mmol reacts। leftoveracid needs NaOH 21mmol। CaCO₃ amount কত mmol?

questions.question_bn: van der Waals gas n=14 mol,b=0.04L/mol,V=14L। available volume V−nb কত L?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 14। Excluded volume correction nb=0.04nL। available V−nb=(14)−0.04×(14)=0.96nL; attraction term আলাদা।

questions.question_bn: H₂SO₄molarity 19/10M; complete both proton neutralisation। normality কত N?

questions.question_bn: Rate=k[A]²[B]। [A] 17 গুণ,[B] half হলে rate ratio কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 17। Rate factor=((17))²×(½)=(17)²/2। coefficient/stoichiometry দিয়ে order replace করা যাবে না।

questions.question_bn: Food oil iodometry-তে I₂ 29mmol মুক্ত। I₂+2S₂O₃²⁻→2I⁻+S₄O₆²⁻। thiosulfate কত mmol?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 29। Reaction coefficients iodine 1 ও thiosulfate 2। তাই nmmol iodine fully titrate করতে 2nmmol thiosulfate।

questions.question_bn: Air1m³-এ pollutant gas 24 cm³, sameT,P। volume ppm কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 24। 1m³=10⁶cm³। ppmV=((24)/10⁶)×10⁶=(24); amount volume ratio একই conditions-এ।

questions.question_bn: Preservative stock 2%w/v। final 600 mL0.10%w/v solution-এ stock কত mL?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 6। Concentration dilution C₁V₁=C₂V₂⇒Vstock=0.10·100×(6)/2=5×(6) mL; তারপর final volume adjust।

questions.question_bn: H₂SO₄0.10M,160 mL পুরো neutralise করতে NaOH 0.20M কত mL?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 16। Acidmoles 0.1·10nmmol=nmmol,base 2nmmol লাগে। V=2×(16)/0.2=10nmL; acid capacity 2explicit।

questions.question_bn: Wet food 150 kg moisture 40%w/w। সব water remove, dry solid unchanged। dry mass কত kg?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 30। Dry fraction 1−0.4=0.6। conserved nonvolatile dry solid=5×(30)·0.6=3×(30) kg; water removed 2×(30)।

questions.question_bn: Acidic 2H⁺+2e⁻→H₂। charge 23F,efficiency 100%। hydrogen mole কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 23। TwoelectrononeH₂; n Faradaymeansnmoleelectrons⇒H₂(23)/2 mol。 atom Hcountmoleculecount ভুলনয়।

questions.question_bn: Acyclic hydrocarbon C5H10 with oneC=C, no ring। sigma-bond count কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 5। C–C skeleton tree has (5)−1sigma, including double-bond oneσ। C–H bonds 2×(5)σ। total 3×(5)−1; πbond excluded।

questions.question_bn: Weak monoprotic acid-strong base titration equivalence at25°C-এ pH সাধারণত কেন 7-এর বেশি?
questions.explanation: Equivalence-এ weak acid-এর conjugate base A⁻ থাকে; A⁻+H₂O⇌HA+OH⁻ basic solution দেয়।

questions.question_bn: 6 mol monohydric alcohol excess Na-এর সঙ্গে react। H₂ produced কত mol?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 6। 2ROH+2Na→2RONa+H₂। alcohol:H₂=2:1; H atom pair করে gas, তাই (6)/2 mol।

questions.question_bn: Benzene nitration-এ active electrophile কী?
questions.explanation: Mixed acid proton at ion/dehydration ofnitricacid nitroniumNO₂⁺ তৈরি করে। electrophilic aromatic substitution-এ ring attack করে।

questions.question_bn: Weak monoprotic HA concentration 0.10M, Ka=9×10⁻⁸। x≪C। [H⁺] approx কত M?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 3। Ka≈x²/C⇒x=√(KaC)=√((3)²×10⁻⁹)=(3)×10⁻⁴⋅⁵। stated approximation check x/C ছোট থাকতে হবে।

questions.question_bn: CaCO₃→CaO+CO₂। pure CaCO₃2400g,100%conversion। Ca Oyield কত g? MCaO 56
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 24। CaCO₃moles=(100×(24))/100=(24)। Ca Omoles 1:1×(24),mass 56ng; CO₂44ngsupports massbalance।

questions.question_bn: Gas mixture 15 mol N₂,2 mol O₂; total pressure 3atm। O₂ partial pressure কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 15। Dalton partial Poxygen=xo₂Ptotal=[2/((15)+2)]·3=6/((15)+2)atm। mole fraction relevant, mass fraction নয়।
